captions_note: the title card and the line under the phone carry the words: fx_add.py hides the reel's captions for those two windows (work/reel_captions.json), and they run in the short full-frame stretch between. Set cap_font and cap_size in STYLE to the reel's caption style
in_a_reel: one continuous shot, about 3 s or more, that starts where the reel's previous shot ends: the card opens on the cut
TITLE is the speaker's own words, a time-jump line fits best. The plain phone has no logo and no real app
the card's first frame is the slot's first frame, the last frames are the plain shot
steps: edit TITLE and the times in the CLIP block when the defaults do not land
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the beats, the words and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
